anyOf.title: InvoiceStatus
anyOf.description:
Status of an invoice.

- `draft`: The invoice isn't ready to use.
- `open`: The invoice is finalized and awaiting payment. If payment fails status
will stay `open`.
- `paid`: Stripe updates invoice from `open` to `paid` if payment succeeds.
- `void`: This invoice is canceled.
- `uncollectible`: The customer is unlikely to pay the invoice. Normally, you
treat it as bad debt in your accounting process.,
